profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Netflix
profile.summary:
C/C++, Java, C#, Python, Embedded System
EGL, OpenGL/ES
Hardware Diagnostic/Debugging
CMake
MFC, COM/COM+, wxWidget, MS-SQL

positions.title: Tech Lead, Diagnostic Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implementing software to test, verify and debug hardware problem.
 -Helping hardware desingers and  test engineers on manuacturing line.
 -Emebbed system, cross compile, concurrent design, debugging and FA.

positions.title: Diagnostic Software Engineer
positions.description:
Diagnostic SW enigeer for Hardware group.
-Implementing software to test/verify and debug hardware problem.

positions.title: Sr. Technical, Software engineer
positions.description:
Working at engine team of Yahoo ConnectedTV group.
Desinging/Implementing cross-platform C/C++ codes.
 -Toolchain build and making build-script for cross-compiling. (Also including ability to generate cross-compiler.)
 -Concurrent programing/debugging skill. 
 -3D graphics for Linux and embedded device. (EGL/OpenGLES)
 -Solving various bugs and issues on embedded devices.
Helping OEM engineers to integrate Yahoo Connected TV product to TV devices.
 -Samsung  and Trident support.

positions.title: Technical, Software engineer
positions.description:
As an engine developer at Yahoo ConnectedTV.
 -Cross-compiling and debugging for embedded system(TV).
 -Writing code for TV devices. (It included performance and memory utilization test.)

positions.title: Software Engineering, Manager
positions.description:
Building Server&Client Framework and GUI Front-End.
HanaPac.BizObject&BizLogic Server(C++, C#, SQL and Socket Programming.)
HanaPac.CodeGenerator(C++, C#, Automated C++ source code Generation tool.)

positions.title: Test Tool Developer
positions.description:
Developing an automated performace test tool for RiskLink.
Rms.TestAutomation (C++, C#, COM, Server/Client Framework)

positions.title: Software Engineer, Internship
positions.description:
For a course work, Practicum Study, worked as a software engineer intern.

TeeLeaf API dojo/jQuery Integration (Ajax, dojo, jQuery)
Passive Capture Application Extending (C, multi process/thread programming)

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
CS326 Operation Systems 
(undergraduate operating system class)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
State Capture Debugger
-Implemented debugger using by machine level state-capture method.

Related Skills : C, Python, WxPython, GCC, x86 Assembly, Qemu, CPU emulation, Debugger, Multi-process&thread programming.

positions.title: Jr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building and maintaining the report framework and GUI tools for ERP system.
Making control tools for GUI frameworks
(SAFE Report , Query Analyzer, SAFE Chart , Web-Folder, Simple Drawer and etc.)

Related Skills : C++, C#, MFC, Win32 API, COM++, ActiveX, Reverse Engineering and SQL
